Naomi / team — attached is the initial calculation workbook (credit-calculation-draft-20261021.xlsx). Summary of approach:

- Incident window used: 2026-10-15T01:42:00Z to 2026-10-15T05:12:00Z (3.5 hours) per cross-referenced infra logs.
- Affected capacity: two dedicated inference clusters serving Luminary’s production region (us-west-2).
- SLA metric: availability-based credit. Using Luminary’s contract: credit = (downtime minutes / SLA period minutes) * monthly recurring charge (MRC) capped per agreement.
- We applied proration for token-volume impacted traffic where retries doubled retry cost during window (adjusted effective MRC downward for the affected percent).

Draft result: proposed credit amount = $18,240 (line-item workbook attached with step-by-step).

Please review figures: I highlighted the retry-adjustment assumptions in column G. If Finance agrees we can package this in the standard SLA credit agreement form.

Attachments: credit-calculation-draft-20261021.xlsx (xlsx, 28 KB)
